<b>Mnemonords</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are a larger form of [[Mnemonid]], barely able to move due to their weight.<ref>Mnemonord [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Huge flighted creature formed from coldshard. This larger form carries so much weight it can barely move from its place."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Mnemonords float in place, dealing {{Damage|1}} on contact. If [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, they blink for a brief moment before creating a ring of icicles around themselves. These icicles shatter after a short delay, but can be broken instantly with an attack. If destroyed, Mnemonords reform in the same location after a few seconds.

They are used primarily for traversal via [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bouncing]] or the [[Clawline]].

== Location ==
Mnemonords can be found in the [[Brightvein]] sub-area of [[Mount Fay]] during Act 3.
